This task adds ONE field (PausedFrom), ONE command kind (resume, admitted from paused only, restoring PausedFrom verbatim and clearing it), ONE Validate clause, three owner-only application commands in a new file, three POST routes, one additive resumes_to field on the requirement detail, and three openapi paths. acceptance_criteria: A1. SCOPE BOUNDARY, and it is built FIRST. Write the five-row table into ALL FOUR evidence records BEFORE any source file is edited. (2) What it deliberately does NOT do: it propagates nothing to a Runner, terminates no Execution, expires no Lease, verifies no stop completion, writes no Control Intent, stages no outbox item, adds no port, adds no environment variable, changes nextAction by not one byte, changes no existing response field, adds no status, and adds no product text -- docs/** is prohibited because every edge is already described.
